plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-13 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Physical Education - Coaching Emphasis program page (poid=11051) and its linked official degree map, 'Physical Education Degree Maps (2026-2027)', tab 'Coaching (Campus)' (the workbook's Index lists Online as N/A for this program), last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (16/13/16/15/15/15/16/14) and the plan to the catalog's printed Total Credits, BS Degree: 120. Per the catalog, all courses must be passed with a C- (1.7) or better to be counted in the major. The catalog curriculum is exercised in full: Required Support Courses 7 (PE 1098, BIOL 1020, BIOL 1025), Core Requirements (headed 37-38 credits; its 17 listed courses itemize to 38, transcribed as listed), Coaching Emphasis 27, and Coaching Electives 6 exercised by the map's three 2-credit 'PE Major Coaching Elective' rows carrying the catalog's eight-course list. PE 4860 Physical Education Practicum is catalogued at 1-3 credits with the note that students must obtain 3 credits from the course; the map places it at 3 in the final term, recorded as placed. PE 1543 carries the catalog's note that students must either take the class or have a current card of completion at graduation. The map's first-term quantitative-literacy row names no course ('MATH - GE Quantitative Literacy*') and is recorded as a generic GE slot. The catalog's Bachelor of Science Degree Requirement (12 credits) notes that a portion may be met by fulfilling the General Education Core and Breadth Areas, so the catalog blocks do not sum arithmetically to 120. The map abbreviates the NFS 1020 title ('Scientific Fnds of Human Nutrition'); the catalog title is recorded. Map free-elective rows total 20 credits, recorded as printed (the catalog prints no free-elective figure).
